narr: A low pressure system pushing northeastward through the Quad State region brought moderate to heavy rain to Western Kentucky for the midday through evening hours. Flash flood and areal flood issues developed late afternoon to early evening in the Purchase Area and Southern Pennyrile where widespread 3 to 4 inch storm total precipitation observations occurred. A water rescue occurred near the Graves/Hickman County line and several vehicles were stranded on Hopkins Rd in Calloway County. CAPE was limited to a couple hundred J/kg. Frontogenesis was oriented west-east across Western Kentucky and precipitable water values were 1.25 to 1.5 inches. River flooding occurred on the S Fork Little River and on the Green River as a result of this heavy rain event.
ev: A stalled vehicle and water rescue occurred around 1700CST on KY-58 at Brush Creek near the Graves and Hickman County line. Radar estimated rainfall was around 2-2.5 inches at the time of the water rescue, with an additional inch of rainfall occurring through the evening hours.

Flooding occurred near Cane Creek with water over US-51 between Gin Rd and KY-1540 and over KY-58 between KY1475 and KY-1540. Approximately 2 inches of rainfall had fallen over the area when road closures were reported, with an additional half inch of rain through the evening hours.
Water was reported over KY-307 between KY-703 and KY-1748. Approximately 2 inches of rain had fallen in this area with an additional half inch during the evening hours.
U.S. 45 south in Water Valley was closed due to water over the road. Approximately 2 inches of rain had fallen with an additional inch through the evening.

At around 1800CST, five vehicles were stranded in high water on Hopkins Rd. Hopkins Rd was closed from KY-464 to Hickory Grove Church Rd. Approximately 2-2.5 inches of rain had fallen in the area at that point, with another inch or so of rain during the evening hours.
